messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: KV-prefix correctness anomaly detected on prod cluster eu-west-2. automatic severity assignment: sev2.
pagerduty-bot: Paging kai (oncall) — please ACK.
kai: acked. seeing elevated error rate on reads that hit prefix cache. logs show cached staleness for some long-tail prefixes. throwing correctness regressions for ~0.8% of requests.
emma: confirmed in dashboards — error spike correlates with prefix pattern `user:session:*` and `conversation:state:*`. TTLs look normal but prefix eviction trampolining observed.
liam: quick note: runtime reports evictions + re-pop cycles at ~4200/s for that keyspace, high cardinality tenants driving it. risk of stale reads when cache returns older snapshots.
jordan: any customer-facing hits? which tenants?
sylvia: flagged two enterprise customers (acme-corp, brightpay) with heavy session churn. downstream correctness tests failing in their test suites.
kai: mitigation plan proposal: 1) temporarily bypass prefix cache for the identified patterns for 30m; 2) apply short-term rate carveouts (soft quota) to noisy tenants; 3) enable read-revalidate path for affected prefixes where possible.
emma: ++ do bypass via config roll: `PUT /config/cache/prefixes` payload: `{"disable_patterns": ["^user:session:", "^conversation:state:"]}` — I can push a canary to 2 nodes first.
liam: also recommend reducing max cache TTL for prefixes globally from 300s -> 60s as a stopgap (will increase backend load but reduces staleness window).
kai: oncall handoff: i'm on for now. if we push changes i'll hand to emma in 40m.
ops-bot: deploy started by emma — canary to eu-west-2-a (2 nodes). watch `cache_metrics.eviction_rate` and `kv_read_errors.correctness` for changes.
emma: canary applied. metrics stream: eviction_rate down 45% on canary, correctness errors still present for ~0.6%. collecting traces.
liam: running a targeted bypass script now to add runtime exclusion for those prefixes:```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/cache/bypass -d '{"patterns":["^user:session:","^conversation:state:"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
liam: bypass committed to 6 nodes. confirmation: bypass active (code 200).
kai: rolling quota carveout for noisy tenants: set tenant rate-limit multiplier = 0.5 for acme-corp and brightpay to reduce backend pressure while correctness path warms.
jordan: customer comms: I'll draft a short message: "We're investigating intermittent stale session responses; temporary mitigation applied; no data loss; working on full fix." send to account reps?
sylvia: please cc SRE and Prod for those accounts. Jordan, ping me when ready — i'll route to account team.
emma: monitoring: `kv_read_errors.correctness` dropped to 0.08% after bypass, backend latency increased ~18% but within SLO.
kai: reasonable. keep bypass for 30m, then evaluate. next steps: 1) collect heap of failing traces -> postmortem; 2) long-term: fix eviction jitter in prefix cache algorithm; 3) examine heuristics for high-cardinality tenant shielding.
liam: started a low-priority background job to refresh hot prefixes proactively (prefetch with revalidation). patch in PR 8934.
jordan: product follow-up: add rollout option for per-prefix consistency mode (strong vs best-effort) so customers can opt in.
sylvia: preparing customer email: short outage notice + steps we took + ETA for root cause analysis.
ops-bot: NOTE: ticket created INC-24432 (assigned to kai/emma/liam).
kai: handing over to emma for next hour of monitoring. emma is oncall-ack.
emma: I have the handoff. will keep bypass in place, start 10m cadence checks; if stable after 30m we'll plan controlled re-enable one AZ at a time.
jordan: docs note: update runbook `prefix-cache-bypass` with the exact curl commands and verification queries.
sylvia: customer comm drafted and approved, sending now. cc: acct reps.
liam: small note for postmortem: include load profile (per-tenant cardinality) & cache eviction trace sample.
kai: thanks team. any blockers for rollback?
emma: none currently. if correctness remains <0.1% and backend latency <25% increase, we can rollback gradually.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — monitoring continued. please file postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:
